_about: Nathaniel Hooke (d. 1763): The Roman History, from the Building of Rome to the Ruin of the Commonwealth, the standard eighteenth-century English history of the Republic, in the six-volume London edition of 1821 (Bavarian State Library scans). Classical scholarship (lane B, round dh). Raw IA OCR. No uids minted.
